post.description:
Generate a structured lesson plan in JSON format.

This endpoint generates a complete lesson plan with structured data
suitable for programmatic consumption. Unlike the streaming endpoint,
this returns a single JSON response.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key (with planning:generate permission)

get.summary: Obtener historial de planificaciones del usuario
get.description: Devuelve una lista de todas las planificaciones generadas por el usuario actualmente autenticado, ordenadas de la más reciente a la más antigua.

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Admin Apikeys  Get

post.description: Create a new API key (Admin only). The API key is only shown once!

Adapt educational content for students with Special Educational Needs (NEE).

Takes original content and adapts it based on student's NEE profile,
applying evidence-based strategies for each identified need. Returns
adapted content with teacher guidance and implementation checklist.

Supported NEE types include: dyslexia, dyscalculia, ADHD, autism spectrum,
visual/hearing impairments, intellectual disabilities, and giftedness.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key (with content:adapt permission)

Generate a quiz based on curriculum OAs.

Creates a structured quiz with various question types suitable for
formative or summative assessment. Questions are aligned to specific
OAs and include Bloom's taxonomy levels.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key (with content:generate permission)

Generate interactive learning activities based on curriculum OAs.

Creates structured activities with steps, resources, timing,
and differentiation options. Supports various activity types
including group work, hands-on, games, and projects.

Generate summative exams with multiple sections.

Creates comprehensive exams with balanced coverage of OAs,
various question types, and optional answer keys and rubrics.

Generate reinforcement materials for struggling students.

Creates a personalized reinforcement plan with various materials
like concept reviews, practice exercises, visual guides, and
worked examples. Includes guidance for teachers and parents.

Generate a unit summary for student study and review.

Creates comprehensive summaries in various formats including
bullet points, concept maps, and flashcard sets. Includes
study questions, common misconceptions, and self-assessment.

Validate educational content against quality criteria.

Performs comprehensive validation including curriculum alignment,
pedagogical quality, content accuracy, age appropriateness,
language quality, accessibility, safety, bias checks, and completeness.

Returns validation status (passed/failed/needs_review), detailed
issues with fix suggestions, and overall quality score.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key (with content:validate permission)

Quick validation check for content (minimal validation level).

A lighter version of validate_content that only checks for
critical errors and safety issues. Faster but less thorough.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key

Submit a batch content generation job.

Creates a batch job that will process multiple content generation
requests asynchronously. Progress and completion are reported via
webhook if configured.

Authentication: API Key with batch:generate permission

get.description:
Get status of a batch job.

Returns current progress and optionally results if completed.

Authentication: API Key

post.description:
Cancel a pending or processing batch job.

Authentication: API Key

get.description:
List batch jobs for the current client.

Authentication: API Key

schema.title: Response List Batch Jobs Api V1 Batch  Get

post.description:
Chat with the AI tutor.

Provides personalized educational support through conversation.
The tutor can explain concepts, guide practice, ask Socratic
questions, provide encouragement, and help with review.

Supports NEE adaptations and different learning styles.

Authentication: JWT token OR API Key (with tutor:chat permission)

get.description:
Get information about a tutoring session.

Returns topics covered and session activity.

delete.description:
End a tutoring session.

Clears session data.
